scope: Android-independent Platform Core A2A Wallet hold, signed handoff request construction, authenticated-source reconnect orchestration seam, Cloud settlement handoff validation, signed usage settlement, and recovery validation
environment: Eclipse Temurin 17 and cached Gradle 8.11.1 offline JVM tests plus Node Cloud-WebCrypto verifier fixture; no Android SDK, production AndroidKeyStore key, APK, Binder, production HTTP transport, or physical device

state: one-time owner approval reserves an exact funded-ledger cap for one immutable A2A delegation
active holds reduce spendable balance and block concurrent approved spending above the remainder
only a pre-dispatch hold can be released; dispatched work remains held when outcome is indeterminate
provider-signed receipt verification is bound to owner, job, delegation, task, agent, currency, price version, deadline, and cap
the exact rock-a2a-wallet-settlement-handoff/1 envelope and a2a.budget.settle command are checked against the local hold before application
reconnect orchestration fetches an owner-scoped handoff through an injected authenticated no-cache source and applies it through Core
transport failure preserves the dispatched hold and never retries remote task execution or releases funds
Java builds the exact short-lived domain-separated Broker request, and a shared RFC-test-key signature vector verifies in both Java and the Cloud WebCrypto implementation
settlement appends one idempotent Wallet debit and releases the unused hold
recoverable backup preserves in-flight holds as RECOVERY_REQUIRED and forbids redispatch or early release
